judgments.reason: The span 'a dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate within the dermis' appears literally in the biopsy findings and directly supports the histological hallmark of Sweet syndrome (acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis).
The span 'marked dermal edema' appears literally in the biopsy findings and is a recognized histological feature of Sweet syndrome, supporting the modifier.
